title: IT494 Reference Papers
subtitle: 142 reference PDFs for the IT 494 memory project; private, per-paper licenses
description: The 142 papers read for the IT 494 memory-backend project, as fetched. `manifest.json` gives bytes, sha256, and the source URL per file; `MANIFEST.md` is the fetch log. Licenses are per paper and mostly do not permit redistribution, so this dataset stays private and is used only as raw input to the project's extractor.
